title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev provides update on X account hack
raw_summary: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev stated a hacker used social engineering to access his X account.  The fraudster gained entry by bypassing standard security features like two-factor authentication.  This hack promoted a memecoin called "Vladhood" on Tenev's compromised account last week.  The account was fully restored and the fake post was removed later that day.  X has since implemented additional safeguards to prevent future security breaches on his account.
